name: Kimi Code Development Environment
description: Installs the Kimi Code IDE extension (moonshot-ai.kimi-code) for VS Code and Cursor, and optionally the kimi CLI. Persists ~/.kimi-code (credentials, config) across rebuilds and Codespaces via a Docker named volume, dedicated to this devcontainer. Also self-heals your devcontainer setup.

username.description: Username in the container that should receive the Kimi Code credentials symlink. 'auto' detects vscode/node/codespace/uid-1000, in that order.

installCli.description: Also install the Kimi Code CLI (kimi command) via the official native installer.
